response.original_title: ((FAQs Guide))How to Add Another room to Your MSC Cruise Reservation
response.overview: To add another room to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and call MSC Cruises customer service at +1-866-829-1280(US) or contact your travel agent to link the two bookings. Book a separate cabin: You cannot add a room to an existing reservation through the online website or mobile app. Book a new stateroom online or via phone. Contact MSC Cruises at +1-866-829-1280(US) or your travel agent. You cannot directly add a new physical stateroom to an existing reservation online; instead, you must book a separate room and have it linked by calling MSC Cruise customer service at +1-866 829-1280 or by contacting your travel advisor. To add an extra room to an existing MSC Cruise reservation, call MSC Cruise at +1-866-829-1280(US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316(UK) or contact your travel advisor, as new cabins cannot be added to an existing booking online.
